Replace 'unpublished' with this citation; note registry enrolment 373 vs paper's 434.

Unverified pointer, no DOI checked: Margolis 2014 cites prior data that TPH1-KO mice have normal GI motility; if the KO itself is taken as the class's functional model, efficacy model_first_use_year could predate 2013. Not required for the current entry.
rule_questions: Juxtaposition across two primary sources: Margolis 2014 (LX1033 leaves mouse motility unchanged; IBS benefit attributed to anti-inflammation) and Delgado-Herrera 2017 (LX1033 no different from placebo) are both peer-reviewed, but neither puts model and patient side by side. Rule 1 says untested; the comparison_stated=false field implies drafter juxtaposition is contemplated. If allowed, efficacy could be scored in 2017 as 'same' (flat motility, flat stool consistency) or as 'contra' against Brown 2011 (LX1031 improved stool consistency despite flat mouse motility). The rules do not decide.

Safety: Brown 2011 (sponsor-authored) attributes the favorable safety profile to 'local site of action ... low degree of oral bioavailability and systemic exposure' without naming the rodent brain-5-HT model. Is a mechanism-attribution sentence in the clinical paper a 'comparison' (same, 2011) or not (untested)? Drafter chose untested; a lenient reading gives same.

Split readout within one source: Brown 2011's quoted comparison is on mucosal 5-HT production (urinary 5-HIAA), which matched; its whole-blood 5-HT did not change at 4 weeks although the Tph1-KO/mouse model predicts blood 5-HT depletion (Liu 2008; Margolis 2014 LX1032 lowered mouse blood 5-HT). The brief has no way to record a same-source partial mismatch; 'same' with magnitude=direction_only hides it.
